leadText:
Kathy (Japanese: キャシー Kathy) is a character of the day who appeared in Must Be Our Heroes and the Witch!.

Kathy runs a café in Stow-on-Side and met , , and when they visited her café for food. When they were impressed with her food, she called out her chef who turned out to be their former traveling companion . Brock had fallen in love with Kathy but was heartbroken when Kathy revealed that she already had a fiancé. After learning this, Brock left her café and joined Ash and Misty on their journey.

A would later create a vision of Kathy to make Brock follow her.
